Manage project memory
Claude regenerates project memory every evening from your past chats in this project. Only you can see this memory, and it is not shared with other project users.

Purpose & context

Kushal (GitHub: kusl) is building MyRestaurant — a self-hosted, single-restaurant ordering and management system licensed under AGPL-3.0. The stack is .NET 10 Blazor Server, PostgreSQL with Dapper only (EF Core explicitly forbidden), DbUp startup migrations, rootless Podman Compose, OpenTelemetry, ASP.NET Core Identity over custom Dapper stores, Argon2id, WebAuthn passkeys, and TOTP. The repo lives at github.com/kusl/myrestaurant. Dependency direction is WebApplication → DataAccess → Domain (Domain is BCL-only). Tests use xUnit v3 with Testcontainers against real PostgreSQL and AwesomeAssertions (no Moq, no FluentAssertions). Local development is on Fedora; primary mobile test target is iPhone SE 2020 (375px viewport).

The project follows a rigorous spec-first, slice-based delivery methodology: each "slice" is an atomic deliverable with code, tests, and documentation updated together. Milestones M1–M5 are complete; M6 (hardening) is active. Work is tracked in docs/TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.md (versioned), docs/DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW.md (F-numbered defect ledger), docs/BUILD_PROGRESS.md, docs/MENU_AND_HANDHELD_PLAN.md, and docs/adr/ (ADR-numbered decision records).

Current state

Kushal is mid-M6, working through a staged menu enhancement and handheld layout plan. As of the most recent slice (M6 Slice 40 / Stage 2 close-out):

Migration 0005_menu_item_sections.sql has been delivered, making menu_item.menu_section_identifier a mandatory FK to menu_section.
Section create page (CreateMenuSection.razor), section picker on item creation, and guest menu rendering grouped under section headings (§7 asymmetry: inactive sections hidden from guests entirely, inactive items visible but marked) are implemented.

Technical specification is at v1.25; predicted test count ~1136.
Stage 1 (handheld layout conversion) is complete: all admin pages use shared §11.12 handheld-first CSS vocabulary with a single min-width: 48rem breakpoint; a 375px reachability barrier (scenario 16) is in place.
Several scope rulings are active: MoveMenuItemToSectionAsync is deliberately deferred (Stage 3); only CreateMenuSectionAsync is behind IMenuWorkflow so far; one scenario 17 assertion (deactivate section → vanishes from guest menu) was cut as out-of-scope and explicitly recorded.
Key active findings to track: F-78 (DbUp dollar-quote fix — .WithVariablesDisabled()), F-79 (duplicated spec paragraph), F-80 (event vocabulary correction).

Key learnings & principles

Atomic documentation rule: every behavior change ships with its spec edits, ADR, ledger row, and changelog entry in the same slice. Violated rules are tracked as F-numbered findings.
Gates must be honest: a gate that reaches past what it can decide reports findings on correct trees (F-41 precedent). Gates assert tree-consistency, not stack behavior (F-51 ruling).
Lists should not exist where a rule can execute (F-47 habit): migration tracking lists replaced by emptiness assertions.
Named findings, not silent drops: if a scope item is cut mid-slice, it is recorded explicitly rather than quietly omitted.
Predicted test counts are uncompiled arithmetic (§18 rule): always flagged as such; any deviation from predicted count is the first item to investigate.
Stale counts in prose are a liability: counts in documentation that no gate can verify should be deleted, not corrected (F-77 ruling).
CSS palette: all color values live in app.css :root; values declared outside it are defects (F-64/F-68 pattern). Eight surfaces with missing palette properties was a near-miss.
Dapper + Npgsql: timestamptz materializes as DateTime (UTC), not DateTimeOffset; always read as DateTime and project to DateTimeOffset via new DateTimeOffset(DateTime.SpecifyKind(value, DateTimeKind.Utc)).
string.Create rule: every operand in a string.Create addition chain must be a $"…" interpolated string; plain literals cause CS1620.
No await in interpolated string holes bound to DefaultInterpolatedStringHandler (CS4007); hoist to a local variable.
DbUp dollar-quote hazard: VariableSubstitutionPreprocessor runs before the statement splitter and misreads $tag$ as variable references; fix with .WithVariablesDisabled() (F-78).
Npgsql in CI: container image references must be fully qualified to avoid silent test skips on canonical hosts (F-60).
Compose variable substitution: Debian trixie's podman-compose does not apply ${NAME:-default} defaults; use explicit env values (F-57).
Blazor enhanced navigation race: WaitForURLAsync resolves when history.pushState fires, before page content arrives; use a destination-specific element as the arrival barrier.
Static SSR intermediate render: StateHasChanged fires the moment OnInitializedAsync suspends; guard against null dereference with else if (_field is not null).
WebAuthn RP-ID: quick tunnels work with per-request RP-ID derivation (ServerDomain = null); named tunnels are still the production path for stable passkey binding.
Approach & patterns

Session workflow: Kushal provides dump.txt (full repo export with SHA-256 per file); Claude reconstructs the working tree, verifies checksums, performs all work, then delivers a .tar.gz archive with repo-relative paths extractable at the repo root. The word "continue" resumes across tool-call ceiling hits.
Delivery format — non-negotiable:
Full files only — never diffs, patches, or bespoke text-manipulation scripts.
Single structured .tar.gz extractable at the repo root.
Explicit "Files to DELETE" section (even when empty).
git add reminders for any new untracked files/directories (gates use git ls-files).
BUILD_PROGRESS.md delivered as a complete file, not an append block.
Documentation updated in every slice.
Veto protocol: consequential architectural decisions, scope rulings, and visible changes are flagged explicitly for Kushal's veto before or immediately after delivery; reversion instructions are provided.
Verification without SDK: brace/bracket/paren balance walks (string-aware), Razor tag-tree comparison against SHA-256-verified originals, CSS selector existence checks, CS4007/CS1620 scans, SpecificationVersionTests ported to Python, shellcheck at --severity=style, YAML parse validation, byte hygiene (no CR, final newline, no whitespace-only lines).
"What was NOT verified" is recorded explicitly in BUILD_PROGRESS.md each slice.
Scope discipline: docs/_append/ delivery mechanism is retired; BUILD_PROGRESS.md ships whole. Unmerged appends still in tree should be cat-merged.
Tools & resources

Repository: github.com/kusl/myrestaurant; dump format via export.sh producing dump.txt with # FILE: / --- CONTENT --- / Size: / SHA-256 headers.
Stack: .NET 10, PostgreSQL 17, Dapper/Npgsql, DbUp, Testcontainers, xUnit v3, AwesomeAssertions, Playwright (E2E), rootless Podman / podman-compose, Caddy, Cloudflare tunnels, OpenTelemetry OTLP.
Key packages: Net.Codecrete.QrCodeGenerator, Konscious Argon2id, CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled for transitive dependency management.
CI: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml, release.yml); local equivalent via scripts/ci_local.sh; scripts/check_tree.sh as gate 1; scripts/check_repository.sh as gate 6.
GitHub PAT: available for read-only API calls; must never appear in any response or generated file.
